name: Abbathor, Avaricious Trovelord
portfolio: Dwarven god of avarice, investment, and thieves
intro: Abbathor is sometimes known as the Wyrm of Avarice, for the Trovelord has such a lust for minerals and metals that it is comparible to the hoarding nature of dragonkind. Abbathor's power and wealth is said to be the reason as to why dwarves are so susceptible to the curse of Dragon Sickness. He surrounds himself with self-interested misers and thieves and lifts from their treasures and feeds them his own to transform them into wyverns and drakes to protect his temples and vaults like guard dogs, giving them the reputation of the most well-guarded treasuries in the multiverse. His position in the Morndinsamman is to protect the treasures of his clan, which the other gods frequently have to force him into submission to relinquish when they are needed.

His realm is Glitterhell, a vault of immeasurable wealth so heavy it has sunk into Oinos in the Grey Wastes of Hades. The gold there cannot be spent and the gems cannot be moved for Abbathor refuses to give up even a fraction of his wealth; the faithful of Abbathor or those damned for their greed who end up there spend eternity surrounded by everything they ever wanted and unable to touch any of it.

infobox.Symbol: Jewelled dagger, pointed down
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven god of avarice, investment, and thieves

name: Asmodeus, Lord of the Nine Hells
portfolio: Greater God of the Hells, Indulgence, Sin and Negotiation
intro: **Asmodeus** (pronounced /ˈæzmoʊdiəs/ AZ-moh-dee-us), known across Ouros as the **Lord of the Nine**, the **Lord of Lies**, and the **King of Baator**, rules the Hells as their first and greatest archdevil. He reigns from Nessus, the ninth and lowest circle of Baator, with total and unquestioned authority. A master of temptation and tyrannical order, he embodies lawful evil in its most absolute expression, binding mortals and immortals alike through oaths, bargains, and forbidden pleasures. His worshippers include devils, corrupt officials, decadent aristocrats, and warlocks who believe their ascent to power lies through the structure of dominance he embodies.

infobox.Symbol: A crown of spiked onyx and curved horns
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Indulgence, Sin, Damnation, Politics, and Negotiation

titles_line: The Devil Lord, Lord of the Ruby Rod, Prince of Evil, the Archfiend, King of Baator, Archduke of Nessus, The Cloven, Lord of Lies, The First Fallen Angel
commandments: Assert dominance and power over others. Show your strength of will in the image of your Lord.
Repay cruelty done unto you with further evil. If others show you kindness, exploit it.
As you ascend to power, do not pity or show mercy to those you climb over to get there. The weak do not warrant your compassion—compassion itself is a weakness.

appendix.title: Vassals of Asmodeus — Archdukes of Baator

members.name: Baalzebul, Archduke of Maladomini
members.blurb: Once a shining prince, now a bloated lord of decay and failed grandeur. His ruined palaces and abandoned projects serve as warnings of pride that refuses to accept imperfection.

members.name: Dispater, Archduke of Dis
members.blurb: Patron of paranoia, surveillance, and iron-walled cities. He rules from the Iron Tower of Dis, an ever-expanding labyrinth of forges, prisons, and archives that model the most oppressive bureaucracies of Ouros.

members.name: Fierna, Archduchess of Phlegethos
members.blurb: The mistress of passion inflamed into cruelty, ruling a sea of living flame where pleasure and pain are indistinguishable tools of control.

members.name: Glasya, Archduchess of Malbolge
members.blurb: Daughter of Asmodeus and mistress of intrigue, rebellion, and “reform” through crime. Her layer is a shifting maze of courts, slums, and gallows, reflecting the corruption of mortal cities.

members.name: Levistus, Archduke of Stygia
members.blurb: A traitor entombed alive within a floating glacier, patron of treachery suspended but never forgiven. His frozen realm attracts those who seek to escape consequences by binding them in time.

members.name: Mammon, Archduke of Minauros
members.blurb: The serpent-coiled lord of avarice and corruption, whose sinking marsh-city drowns those who mistake wealth for worth. He is invoked by embezzlers, usurers, and those who trade lives for coin.

members.name: Mephistopheles, Archduke of Cania
members.blurb: Master of infernal arcana and experimental sorceries, ruling a plane of impossible cold. He tempts mages with forbidden formulae and offers empires new weapons in exchange for concessions of law and soul.

members.name: Zariel, Archduchess of Avernus
members.blurb: Once a fiery angel of war, who in a fit of rage descended into the hells and slaughtered legions of Hell alone, and now the infernal marshal of crusades in the Blood War and bargains made for martial glory. Her layer is a battlefield-scoured wasteland where armies of devils and mortals alike march in endless campaigns.

name: Avandra, the Changebringer
portfolio: Greater Goddess of Change, Freedom, Revolution, Travel, and Luck
intro: **Avandra** (pronounced /əˈvændrə/ uh-VAN-drə), also known as **She Who Makes the Path**, is the **Changebringer**, champion of freedom, luck, and the open road. She wanders the Outer Planes without rest, though the Beastlands are where she is most often found at ease. Her will heralds open frontiers, and her call beckons her followers to discover what awaits beyond the known. There are few urban temples dedicated to her, but her shrines are often found along well-traveled roads and on isolated wilderness hilltops. Merchants, adventurers, and free-spirited folk worship her widely, and many a gala toast and tavern song celebrate her as a bringer of luck and fortune.

infobox.Symbol: Woman's profile embossed on a gold coin or pendant
infobox.Portfolio: Greater Goddess of Change, Freedom, Revolution, Travel, and Luck
infobox.Divine Realm: Happy Hunting Grounds of the Beastlands

titles_line: She Who Makes the Path, Lady Luck, Wanderling, Tymora (by halflings)
commandments: Luck favors the bold. Your fate is your own to grasp, and to do so is to have the Changebringer behind you.
Change is inevitable. The righteous can ensure that such change is for the better.
Rise up against tyranny. Fight for the freedom of yourself and others when you can, and inspire others to fight when you cannot.

name: Bahamut, the Platinum Dragon
portfolio: Greater God of Virtue, Honour, and Justice
intro: **Bahamut** (pronounced /bəˈhæmʊt/ buh-HAM-ut), the **Platinum Dragon**, is revered as the first and greatest of the metallic dragons and the exemplar of enlightened justice, a beacon of order and good to paladins everywhere. He rules from his palace in Mercuria, the second layer of Mount Celestia, and his crest adorns many halls of high leadership and judgment, invoking his will in all matters of justice. To follow him is to look after those who cannot look after themselves, upholding a justice that is stern against evil yet tempered with mercy and forgiveness for the penitent.

infobox.Symbol: A silver dragon's head in profile
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Virtue, Honour, Justice, Good-aligned Dragons
infobox.Worshippers: Dragonborn, knights, metallic dragons, nobles, paladins

titles_line: the Platinum Dragon, Xymor, The Valiant, Lord of the North Wind, The Dracopaladin
commandments: Stand as a paragon of honor and justice.
Smite evil wherever it is found, yet show compassion to those who have strayed from righteousness.
Defend the weak, bring freedom to the persecuted, and protect the ideals of justice and order.

name: Bane, the Strife Emperor
portfolio: Greater God of Conflict, Discipline, Oppression, and Warfare
intro: **Bane** (pronounced /beɪn/ BAYN), known as the **Strife Emperor** and the **Black Hand**, is the patron of despots, warlords, drill-sergeants, and blood-drenched conquerors who seek to bend the world beneath ordered violence. Brutal empires and many goblinoid tribes worship him as they strike out to break lesser peoples and grind them into disciplined servitude. From Banehold, his dread realm amid the endless Battlefields of Acheron, he acts indirectly through his priests, champions, and goblinoid demigods, pursuing a single, unchanging goal: total domination under his iron will.

infobox.Symbol: A steel gauntlet clutching a rusted chain
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Conflict, Discipline, Oppression, Strategy, Warfare and patron of Goblinkind

titles_line: Strife Emperor, the Black Hand
commandments: Fear is your ally. Conquer your fear, and inspire it in your foes.
Disorder and rebellion are to be punished severely.
To kill is life's greatest pleasure, and perfecting the art of slaughter is life's greatest pursuit.

name: Berronar Truesilver, Revered Mother
portfolio: Dwarven goddess of hearth, honesty, medicine, oaths and safety
intro: Berronar Truesilver is the matriarch of the Morndinsamman, whose marriage to the All-Hammer formed the pantheon as it exists today by uniting their two families into a single clan. All values of dwarvenkind trace back to the household she and her husband established at the founding of the pantheon. Dwarven culture does not merely worship Berronar but is modelled on her governance. Every clan hall, every sworn oath, every stronghold and its history reflects the household she founded.

Her realm is Dwarfhome, shared with her Moradin. It is the destination of dwarves who have lived well by the standards of the clan: those who kept their oaths, maintained a welcome home, and upheld their obligations to kin. For the dwarven faithful it represents not reward so much as homecoming, a final return to the household from which all dwarven life descends.

infobox.Symbol: Intertwined silver rings
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven goddess of hearth, honesty, medicine, oaths and safety

name: Clangeddin Silverbeard, Rock of Battle
portfolio: Greater God of Battle, Dwarven god of battle, bravery, honour, sports, and war
intro: Clangeddin Silverbeard is the greatest warrior of the dwarven gods, celebrated for leading dwarven hosts against their enemies in the ancient wars that define dwarven martial history. He is impetuous and merry in battle, a cunning strategist who sings stirring ballads and taunting ditties in equal measure mid-fight, and who extends his approval to shrewd strategy as readily as to raw courage. He never surrenders and brookes no treachery, holding that victory won by craven means is no victory at all.

His realm is Mount Clangeddin, a mountain of over thirty thousand feet, for petitioners and warriors raid Acheron and Nishrek regularly, pressing the old grudges of dwarven history forward into eternity.

infobox.Symbol: Crossed bearded axes
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven god of battle, bravery, honour, sports, and war

name: Corellon Larethian, the Arch-Seldarine
portfolio: Greater God of Stars, Magic, Artistry, and Reincarnation
intro: **Corellon Larethian** (pronounced /kɒˈrɛlɒn ˌlærəˈθiːən/ kor-EL-on la-reh-THEE-an), known as the **Arch-Seldarine**, is the fey progenitor of the Seldarine pantheon and is considered the parent of all elves, for it was by their hand that the first elves wandered from Faerie. They hold court in the Crescent Grove of Arvandor, within Arborea, where the Seldarine is as fluid and changeable as a breeze or a brook, quick to anger but equally quick to forgive and forget. Anyone who has felt his mystical presence describes it as a joy like no other, followed by a deep melancholy when it fades. Those who seek art in all their work, whether magic or mundane, often worship at their altar, and loathe the Spider Queen and her priestesses for leading the drow astray.

infobox.Symbol: Two crescent moons facing each other atop a four-pointed star
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Stars, Magic, Artistry, Reincarnation, and Elves

titles_line: The Arch-Seldarine, the Arch-Heart, The Ascended Archfey, Their Brilliance
commandments: Create, inspire, and find beauty in all that you do.
Follow the echoes of lost magic, forgotten sites,and ancient art, for within these lie the Seldarine's first works.
Combat the followers of the Spider Queen wherever they may be.

members.name: Aerdrie Faenya — She of Azure Plumage

name: Deep Duerra, Queen of the Invisible Art
portfolio: Greater God of the Invisible Art, Duergar goddess of psionics and conquest
intro: Deep Duerra is a hero-goddess who took mortal form to steal the secrets of illithid psionics from the mind flayers who enslaved her people, and led the duergar rebellion that broke that enslavement. The psionic power the duergar carry is her inheritance to them, seized rather than gifted, and she remains the patron of their ongoing conquest of the Underdark. She sits among the exiled members of the Morndinsamman, cast out alongside her predecessor for doctrines the clan would not sanction, and rules her following from beyond the reach of the family that disowned her.

Her realm is the Citadel of Thought, a fortress of psionic architecture built into one of the hollow iron cubes that drift through Thuldanin. It is where her faithful continue the conquest she began in life, and where the psionic secrets she stole from the illithids are studied and expanded without limit.

infobox.Symbol: Cracked illithid skull
infobox.Portfolio: Duergar goddess of conquest and psionics

name: Diinkarazan, Twin Betrayed
portfolio: Derro god of curses, insanity and vengeance
intro: Diinkarazan is the twin of the derro's patron god, betrayed by him and left to have his mind consumed by Ilsensine while his sibling fled with stolen magic. He has no organised worship; the derro shamans mention him only to praise his brother's cunning escape at his expense, and whatever faithful he retains he holds through misdirection and the pull of his madness rather than any doctrine or covenant. He is released from his prison once every fifty years for a single day and spends it hunting derro communities in revenge for their abandonment of him.

The Prison of the Mad God is not a true layer of the Abyss but a plane torn between Carceri and Pandemonium, its imprisoning and maddening qualities balanced so precisely between the two that it cannot slip into either, leaving it suspended in the Abyss instead. At its centre is a gem-set throne within a perpetual vortex of wind, gas, and orbiting stone, to which Diinkarazan is bound.

infobox.Symbol: A ring with seven bloody diamonds
infobox.Portfolio: Derro god of curses, insanity and vengeance

name: Diirinka, Betrayer Savant
portfolio: Derro god of magic, knowledge, and cruelty
intro: The Betrayer Savant is the creator of the derro, the god who backstabbed his twin to escape with stolen magic and spent the centuries that followed experimenting on dwarves in secret, discarding the failures as mindless abominations in isolated cave complexes until the derro emerged as his perfected work. He is the most powerfully magical of all the dwarven deities, which played no small part in his disownment from the clan; he was not merely exiled as the duergar gods were, but struck from the family entirely. Among the derro he rules through the savants, whose sorcerous power is not granted but physically shaped into them by his direct intervention before birth.

His realm is Hidden Betrayal, a place so thoroughly concealed that no visitor has ever returned to describe it. He guides no one, sends no omens, and intervenes only when a magical acquisition or act of cruelty draws his personal interest.

infobox.Symbol: A cruel and jagged smile
infobox.Portfolio: Derro god of cruelty, knowledge and magic

name: Dugmaren Brightmantle, Errant Explorer
portfolio: Dwarven god of learning and innovation
intro: Dugmaren Brightmantle is the most chaotic of the Morndinsamman, a divine embodiment of the industrial progressivism and exploratory streak that dwarven culture carries beneath its conservatism. He pursues knowledge regardless of its utility, abandons projects the moment something more interesting presents itself, and has ruined things he was not supposed to touch more times than any of his kin care to count. He is tolerated by even the most lawful members of the clan because his inventions, however haphazardly arrived at, have proven their worth often enough to justify the chaos that surrounds him.

His realm is Soot Hall, caverns coated in millennia of forge-ash, filled with furnaces, workshops, and libraries of esoteric lore, and never quiet for he grants his petitioners the ability to work without need for sleep.

infobox.Symbol: Open book
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven god of learning and innovation

name: Dumathoin, Keeper Under the Mountain
portfolio: Dwarven god of mining, ore, gems, and the dead
intro: Dumathoin is the Silent Keeper, a mute god who prepared the mountains for the coming of dwarves before they arrived, seeding veins of precious metal and gem deposits through the deep places of the world to be found when his people were ready. As he prepared the mountains for their arrival, so too does he prepare them for their return: he is the guardian of the dwarven dead, maintaining the sanctity of their tombs and guiding their souls onward. He never speaks, communicating only in gestures, which has the effect of placing him above the internal conflicts of the Morndinsamman by default.

His realm is Deepshaft Hall, the lowest district of the Dwarven Mountain, its caverns rich with ore and natural gems left untouched. It reaches deep toward the centre of the Outlands and overlaps in places with the realm of the illithid god Ilsensine, an arrangement that is nonhostile between the two gods and entirely hostile between their followers.

infobox.Symbol: Gemstone inside a mountain
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven god of mining, ore, gems, and the dead

name: Eilistraee, Lady Silverhair
portfolio: Greater Goddess of Individuality, Night, and Witchcraft
intro: **Eilistraee** (pronounced /eɪlɪˈstreɪ/ ay-lih-STRAY), known as **Lady Silverhair** and the **Darkmaiden**, is the patron of those who have been told to be ashamed of what they are, and refused. Drow who have abandoned Lolth's web, witches who practice in open defiance, and those who have spent long years wearing masks they did not choose all find her in the open sky when they finally take it off. She makes her home in Svartalfheim, a realm of deep forests and open glades beneath a starlit sky that shows no moon, where the dark is not something to hide in but something to finally be seen against. Her faithful dance beneath the open night not as ritual but as declaration.

infobox.Symbol: Nude drow dancer wielding a sword against a silver moon
infobox.Portfolio: Greater Goddess of Individuality, Night, and Witchcraft
infobox.Worshippers: Surface drow, minotaur, swordfighters, women, and witches

titles_line: The Darkmaiden, Lady Silverhair
commandments: Walk your own path, express your true self, and defend others’ right to do the same. Walk the night unafraid, and help others do the same.
Stand against Lolth’s cruelty wherever it spreads, but remember her faithful are being deceived.
Offer compassion to the lost and the exiled, that they may find a place in the world.

name: Erathis, the Lawbearer
portfolio: Greater Goddess of Law, Civilization, Commerce, Peace, and Progress
intro: **Erathis** (pronounced /ɛˈrɑːθɪs/ eh-RAH-thiss), also known as the **Lawbearer** and the **Cobalt Lady**, represents the order and structure that allows societies to flourish. A patron of judges, lawmakers, city-builders, and inventors, she claims dominion over civilization from Hestavar, her city adrift in the Astral Sea. Judges and lawful rulers pay respect at her temples, which stand as central structures in major cities around the world. She keeps a tempestuous romance with the Wildmother, a furious love that is only tempered when civilization and nature are in balance; civil unrest and riots blossom within her beloved cities when that balance fails.

infobox.Symbol: Double-headed axe inset with a pattern of scales
infobox.Portfolio: Greater Goddess of Law, Civilization, Commerce, Peace, and Progress.

titles_line: Lawbearer, Steel Lady
commandments: Utilize the company and aid of others. The efforts of the individual often pale against the capabilities of community.
Strive to tame the wilds in the name of civilization,and defend the points of light and order against the chaos of darkness.
Uphold and revere the spirit of invention. Create new settlements, build where inspiration strikes,and expand the edicts of the Lawbearer.

name: Garl Glittergold, the Gemheart
portfolio: Greater God of Artifice, Celebration, Jewels, and Wealth
intro: **Garl Glittergold** (pronounced /gɑːrl ˈglɪtərɡoʊld/ GARL GLIT-er-gold), the **Gemheart**, asks only this of the world: that it not take itself too seriously. He is the laughing patron of invention and celebration, a golden-skinned eccentric who breathed the first gnomes into life from gems plucked off a cavern wall. He won their trust with a very good joke before leading them into the wider world beyond it. He wanders freely throughout the Golden Hills, a seven-peaked realm on the plane of Bytopia, though his own hill of Glitterhome sits at its heart and he is rarely found there. His clerics understand that wealth is not only gold, but the richness of a life well-lived.

infobox.Symbol: A gold nugget
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Artifice, Celebration, Jewels, Wealth, and Gnomes

titles_line: Lord of the Golden Hills, the Gemheart, the Merry Tinkerers
commandments: Seek wonder in every cavern, forest, and corner of the world.
Never take yourself too seriously, lest you lose touch with those you protect and care for.
Do not fear change or the unorthodox — therein lies the future.

members.name: Baravar Cloakshadow, the Lord of Sly Disguise
Gaeldal Ironhand, the Shield of Goldenhills
Nebelun the Meddler — the Interloping Inventor
Segojan Earthcaller, Lord of the Burrow

name: Gendwar Argrim, Doomed Dwarf
portfolio: Dwarven god of swansongs, obsession, urgency, and the unfinished
intro: Gendwar Argrim is the Doomed Dwarf, the god called upon when a dwarf knows their time is short and their work is not yet finished. He asks nothing of those who pray to him except that they spend whatever remains of themselves on what matters, and his answer to prayers is not the promise of survival but just enough time to achieve their goals. He is not a god of death or battle specifically, but of the unfinished and the urgent, invoked by warriors in losing fights and elders in failing health alike.

His realm is the Final Hall, a fortress deep in Abellio whose gates are always open and whose inhabitants are always working. Nothing in it is complete. Every project is mid-construction, every campaign mid-march, every song unfinished. His petitioners do not rest there; they continue.

infobox.Symbol: Cracked axe
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven god of swansongs, obsession, urgency, and the unfinished
infobox.Worshippers: Dwarves soon to die, the obsessed

commandments: The only hope the dwarven race has to survive is if its enemies are utterly destroyed. Focus on their destruction. They breed faster than the True Folk and spawn ten times our numbers within one dwarven generation.
Honour, glory, wealth, and love are all meaningless and trivial while the future is at stake.
Expect to die in battle, but make your death cost a thousand enemies their own. If the dwarves survive only in song and legend, ours will be an empty legacy.

name: Gorm Gulthyn, Lord Bronzemask
portfolio: Dwarven god of guardians, protection, and vigilance
intro: Gorm Gulthyn is the sentinel of the Morndinsamman, the guardian who ranges ceaselessly across dwarven holds to place himself between his people and whatever threatens them. He keeps vigils on battlefronts, sets deadfalls in passages near enclaves, and manifests wherever dwarves face armed invasion or dangerous monsters, holding nothing back before moving on to the next crisis. He is stern, humourless, and perpetually consumed by his duties, appearing only when dwarves are already in danger and never staying longer than the immediate threat requires.

His realm is Watchkeep, a tower built in Dwarfhome from which he maintains constant surveillance of every portal and passage in the plane. Dwarves who died defending their holds against impossible odds are granted the right to stand guard there, continuing in death the watch they kept in life.

infobox.Symbol: Bronze mask with burning eyes
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven god of guardians, protection, and vigilance

name: Gruumsh One-Eye, the Ruiner
portfolio: Greater God of Natural Disasters, Curses, Outcasts, and Strength
intro: **Gruumsh** (pronounced /gruːmʃ/ GROO-msh), known as **One-Eye** and **the Ruiner**, rules the orcish pantheon from Nishrek, his fortress amid the Battleplains of Acheron. He is said to have carved the first orcs from wild boars, tusked and relentless in his own image. To his faithful, the world is a kill-or-be-killed hunting ground where only raw strength and ruthless will deserve to endure. He despises walls, laws, and comforts as lies that shelter the weak, and preaches earthquakes, plague, and volcanic fire as his scouring gifts, great culls that leave only the hard and the worthy standing.

infobox.Symbol: A single, unlinking, bleeding eye
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Natural Disasters, Curses, Outcasts, Strength, and Orcs
infobox.Divine Realm: Nishrek, Avalas, Myriad Battlefields of Acheron

titles_line: The Ruiner, The Cursed God, He Who Never Sleeps
commandments: Raid. Take what you need to survive and thrive.
Strength is all. The strongest rules. This is the only law.
There are no emotions but fury and joy. The rest are weakness.

members.name: Bahgtru — Fist of the Chieftain
members.blurb: Orc god of brute strength and unquestioning loyalty.

members.name: Ilneval — the Hordemaker
members.blurb: Orc god of strategy and command, patron of war-leaders.

members.name: Luthic — Bloodmoon Mother
members.blurb: Orc goddess of healing and fecundity, who tends the tribe so it can continue fighting.

members.name: Shargaas — the Stalker Below
members.blurb: Orc god of darkness, dishonour, and murder.

members.name: Yurtrus — the White-Handed
members.blurb: Orc god of disease and decay, keeper of plagues and slow, suffocating deaths.

name: Haela Brightaxe, Lady of the Fray
portfolio: Greater God of the Fray, Dwarven goddess of luck, anticipation, and circumstance
intro: Haela Brightaxe is the Luckmaiden, the youngest of the Morndinsamman and the goddess who ranges across the planes to appear wherever dwarves face the worst odds, throwing herself into the thickest of it with infectious enthusiasm. She takes risks without hesitation, trusts fortune to see her through, and treats the chaos of a hard-fought battle as its own reward. She is gregarious and upbeat where most of the clan is dour, which earns her the patient tolerance of her elders and the fierce devotion of the dwarves she fights alongside.

Her realm is Findar Endar, a grotto hidden deep within a forest, tended by the souls of her favourite fallen warriors who serve as its guardians. She is rarely there, being almost always elsewhere in the planes where dwarves need her most.

infobox.Symbol: Upright sword with blade sheathed in flame
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven goddess of luck, anticipation, and circumstance

name: Hanseath, the Hirsute Boozer
portfolio: Dwarven god of alcohol, festivals, and song
intro: Hanseath is the Bearded Brewer, the god who waits at the end of the working day with a full tankard and a song already started. He is the loudest member of the Morndinsamman and the least interested in duty for its own sake, holding that a dwarf who never rests never truly appreciates what they are working for.

His realm is the Raucous Hall, a feast hall where the ale never runs dry and the songs get louder as the night goes on. His petitioners work no shifts and keep no schedules, and the only obligation in the hall is to enjoy being there.

infobox.Symbol: Frothy tankard of ale
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven god of alcohol, festivals, and song

name: Ioun, the Knowing Mentor
portfolio: Greater Goddess of Truth, Knowledge, Lore, Skill, and Wizardry
intro: **Ioun** (pronounced /aɪˈuːn/ eye-OON), the **Knowing Mentor**, keeps the **Endless Atheneum** adrift in the Astral Sea, where she is revered by sages, seers, archivists, and tacticians, and by any who live by wit and learning rather than strength of arm. She guided the growth of civilization throughout the ages like sunlight guides the branches of a tree. Her teachings were silenced when she was grievously wounded by the Chained Oblivion during the Calamity, and though she survived and went into hiding behind the Divine Gate, her followers are hunted by agents of her ancient foes to this day. Truth and Knowledge, she teaches, cannot be quelled so easily.

infobox.Symbol: Pair of open eyes crowned with a third open eye
infobox.Portfolio: Greater Goddess of Truth, Education, Knowledge, Language, Lore, Prophecy, Skill, and Wizardry

titles_line: The Knowing Mentor, Knowing Mistress, Cobalt Prophet, Knowing Goddess of Truth.
commandments: Unmask those who would destroy the Knowing Mentor. Learn their secrets and unveil them to the world.
Uphold and teach the importance of reason, perception, and truth in guiding one's emotions and path.
Condemn those who lie without moral cause, for evil folk gain power when their followers obscure the truth. Never stoop to the level of selfish liars.

name: Kord, the Stormwarrior
portfolio: Greater God of Storms, Skies, Athletics, Battle, Heroes, and Victory
intro: **Kord** (pronounced /kɔːrd/ KORD), the **Stormwarrior**, is the Ourosi god of storms, the sky, and heroic contest. He makes his home upon the high mountains of Jotunheim, though he holds no rule there; giants honor him as a demigod within their own pantheon, and warriors, sailors, and athletes across Ouros call on him for victory. He reveals himself in every test of strength, and his blessing finds those who prove themselves on the battlefield or in the arena. He brings tumultuous storms over land and sea, and those who wish for clearer skies offer their praises to appease him.

infobox.Symbol: Four bolts of lightning radiating from the centre of a shield
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Storms, Skies, Athletics, Battle, Heroes, Victory, and patron of Giants
infobox.Worshippers: Goliath, athletes, giants, giantkin, gladiators, heroes, sailors, warriors

titles_line: The Stormwarrior, The Dragonslayer God, the Testing Tempest
commandments: Bravery above all. There is no glory in cowardice.
Strength is the path to greatness, but greatness is the responsible use of strength.
The glory of the Stormlord lives through your own glory on the battlefield.

name: Laduguer, Exile in Grey
portfolio: Dwarven god of artificers, exploitation and toil

infobox.Symbol: Broken arrow
infobox.Portfolio: Duergar god of artificers, exploitation and toil

name: Lamashtu, Mother of Monsters
portfolio: Greater Goddess of Monsters, Corruption, Famine, Evolution, and Vermin
intro: **Lamashtu** (pronounced /ləˈmæʃtuː/ luh-MASH-too), the **Mother of Monsters**, is older than the current order of the Abyss, an Obyrith queen who existed before the Tanar'ri themselves, and who pressed both into a fraction of them to make the first demon lords. She rules from Kurnugia, a realm of warped terrain and ancient warrens where her children are born and remade without end. Gnolls, goblins, the deformed, and the discarded worship her not for healing of these forms, but for the conviction that what the world calls an abomination is simply something it does not yet have the courage to understand.

infobox.Symbol: A three-eyed jackal head
infobox.Portfolio: Greater Goddess of Monsters, Corruption, Famine, Evolution, and Vermin

titles_line: Mother of Monsters, Obyrith Queen
commandments: Never change that which makes you different
Make the beautiful monstrous, and the monstrous beautiful
Reveal the corruption and flaws in all things

appendix.title: Abyssal Lords — Demon Princes of the Abyss

name: Lolth, the Spider Queen
portfolio: Greater Goddess of Nightmares, Betrayal, Espionage, Manipulation, and Seduction
intro: **Lolth** (pronounced /loʊlθ/ LOHLTH or /lɒlθ/ LOLTH), known in elder elven myths as **Aurashnee**, is chief patron of the drow and the Dark Seldarine. Once a lesser elven goddess of destiny and artisans and consort to Corellon, she retreated into the Abyss after a failed coup against the Seldarine and was remade as the **Demon Queen of Spiders**, ruling the Demonweb Pits. Feared as much as she is worshipped, Lolth embodies treachery elevated to a sacred principle: she demands ruthless ambition, cultivates obsessive mistrust, and delights in turning kin against kin. Among the elves she is reviled as the architect of the drow's fall; among drow, she is both jailer and patron.

infobox.Symbol: A bejewelled spider
infobox.Portfolio: Greater Goddess of Nightmares, Betrayal, Espionage, Manipulation, Seduction, and Drow
infobox.Divine Realm: Demonweb Pits, 66th Layer of the Abyss
infobox.Worshippers: Drow, assassins, matriarchal societies, spiders, spies

titles_line: Queen of Spiders, Lady of Demonwebs, Mistress of Lies
commandments: It is better to be loved than feared, but you may certainly try to be both.
Misdirection, slander, and shadowed steps have more function than direct conflict.
Death to the elves who live under the stars, and death to all their allies!

name: Marthammor Duin, Watcher over Wanderers
portfolio: Dwarven god of travellers and weather
intro: Marthammor Duin is the Finder-of-Trails, the most openly curious member of the Morndinsamman, whose interest lies in the world beyond the clanholds of dwarvenkind. He watches over dwarves who have left their holds to live or travel among other people, and is the god most likely to be invoked by a dwarf far from home.

His realm is the Cavern of Rest beneath Nidavellir, guarded by the souls of dwarves who died travelling far from home and by war dogs and boars he trained himself. Very rarely is he found within his realm, instead following whatever paths throughout the planes he has not yet walked.

infobox.Symbol: Upright mace above a fur-trimmed boot
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven god of travellers and weather

name: The Raven Queen, the Duskmaven
portfolio: Greater Goddess of Death, the Afterlife, Fate, Psychopomps, and Winter
intro: The **Matron of Ravens**, mistress of winter and keeper of the skein of fate, is the Ourosi god of death. She rules from Letherna, her demiplane within the Shadowfell, and her gaze follows and marks the end of every mortal life, watching over the transition between life and death to ensure it goes undefiled. Mourners at funerals across the land invoke her blessing in hopes she will protect the deceased from the terrible curse of undeath. She is the only mortal known to have achieved apotheosis before the Age of Faith, the era marked by the Divine Gate's creation, when the gods lost the power of direct intervention and were forced to rely on worship alone; Vecna's ascension, by contrast, came after that threshold, and is recent history by comparison.

infobox.Symbol: A white, featureless humanoid mask framed in black feathers.
infobox.Portfolio: Greater Goddess of Death, the Afterlife, Fate, Psychopomps, and Winter

titles_line: Matron of Ravens, Duskmaven, Ebon Queen
commandments: Death is the natural end of life. Grieve the fallen, but do not pity them. Exult in the time that they were granted.
The path of Fate is sacrosanct. Those who pridefully cast off destiny must be punished.
Undeath is an atrocity. Death is too good a punishment for those who pervert the rightful transition of the soul.

name: Melora, the Wildmother
portfolio: Greater Goddess of Nature, Beasts, Hunters, Seas, and Wilderness
intro: **Melora** (pronounced /məˈlɔːrə/ muh-LOR-uh), widely known as the **Wildmother**, is as much beast as woman, both predator and prey, embodying every part of the living world's hunger and its gentleness. She roams the Beastlands, present in docile grasslands and calm tides as surely as in apex predators and the slow reclamation of fallen cities by root and wave. Hunters, druids, sailors, and nomads revere her as the mother of untamed places and the shifting ocean, seeking her blessing to live in harmony with lands and waters that still bear their wild fangs.

infobox.Symbol: A wreath of plantlife affixed to an anchor or crook.
infobox.Portfolio: Greater Goddess of Nature, Beasts, Hunters, Seas, Wilderness and patron of Beastfolk.
infobox.Divine Realm: Happy Hunting Grounds of the Beastlands

titles_line: Serataani, Wildmother
commandments: Protect the untamed wilderness from exploitation and destruction.
Slay abominations and other mockeries of nature.
Embrace and respect that which you cannot control in this world. Exist in harmony with it.

name: Moradin, the All-Hammer
portfolio: Greater God of Creation, Artisans, Harmony, Loyalty, Labour, and Machines
intro: **Moradin** (pronounced /ˈmɔːrədɪn/ MOR-uh-din), also known as the **All-Hammer**, **Dwarf Father**, and **Forger of Souls**, is chief of the Morndinsamman and patron of the dwarven race as a whole. He rules from Dwarfhome, his hall within Mount Celestia, and is revered as the master of every craft his children practice and the architect of their souls. Smiths, artisans, and miners worship him alike, granting inspiration where respect and prayer are given. Devotion to him is strongest in dwarven communities, even giving claim to the Spears of Erenval, said to be the mountains from which dwarves first sprung upon Ouros.

infobox.Symbol: A hammer with ends carved in the likeness of dwarven heads
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Creation, Artisans, Harmony, Loyalty, Labour, Machines, and Dwarves
infobox.Worshippers: Dwarves, artisans, craftsmen, engineers, guildmasters, and labourers

titles_line: The All-Hammer, Dwarf Father, Forger of Souls
commandments: Remain stoic and tenacious in the face of catastrophe.
Uphold and promote loyalty to your family, loyalty to your clan, and loyalty to your people.
Legacy is paramount. To create something that lasts is to change the world for the better.

members.name: Haela Brightaxe — Lady of the Fray
Thard Harr — Dwarf of Jungle Deeps
Deep Duerra — Queen of the Invisible Art

name: Mya, Arch-Völva
portfolio: Dwarven goddess of divination, fertility, sagas, and wisdom
intro: Mya is the Voice of Wisdom, the goddess to whom dwarves turn when the question is not what to build or how to fight but what to remember and what to pass on. Dwarven myth holds that Moradin sought her counsel before breathing souls into the elemental Azer he had shaped from fire and stone, and that it was Mya who told him what a mortal people would need to survive across generations. The proliferation of twins and triplets among dwarves is attributed to her hand, the first gift she gave to a people whose survival would depend on the bonds between those who shared a womb.

Her realm is the Hearth Eternal, a vast longhouse of warm firelight with every wall inscribed with the sagas of dwarven bloodlines stretching back to the first generation. Her petitioners spend eternity ensuring that nothing a dwarf ever lived and learned is lost.

infobox.Symbol: Silhouetted mother figure with hands raised
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven goddess of divination, fertility, sagas, and wisdom
infobox.Worshippers: Clan elders, diviners, loremasters, mothers, storytellers

name: Pelor, the Dawnfather
portfolio: Greater God of Dawn, Agriculture, Martyrs, Summer, and the Sun
intro: **Pelor** (pronounced /ˈpeɪlɔːr/ PAY-lore), also known as the **Dawnfather** and the **Shining One**, rules from Light's Blessing, his realm within the Blessed Fields of Elysium. As lord of agriculture and harbinger of the harvest, he is worshiped by farmers and common folk alike, and his priests are welcomed in many lands. Supporter of the needy and destroyer of evil, he is often the patron of paladins and rangers who follow a similar creed. He is remembered for his defeat of the Chained Oblivion and is revered by those who hunt aberrations. Though he does not govern time itself, Pelor is widely regarded as the calendarist of reality.

infobox.Symbol: A bright, eight-pointed star
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Dawn, Agriculture, Martyrs, Summer, the Sun, and patron of Humans
infobox.Divine Realm: Light's Blessing, Amoria, Blessed Fields of Elysium

titles_line: Dawnfather, Shining One
commandments: Be ever vigilant for evil. People are quick to forget the lessons of the past.
Help relieve the suffering of the innocent.
Deliver the light of the Dawnfather where darkness dwells, and do so with kindness, compassion, and mercy.

name: Sarenraei, the Everlight
portfolio: Greater Goddess of Redemption, Altruism, Fire, and Healing
intro: **Sarenraei** (pronounced /ˈreɪ.i/ RAY-ee), the **Everlight**, embodies temperance and patience, teaching that even hardened hearts can be turned toward the light. She rules from the Island of Renewal within the Blessed Fields of Elysium, and believes wholly that the corrupt can be redeemed, a conviction that led to a betrayal by the Lord of the Hells, who decimated her followers during the Divergence. Only recently has her faith been rediscovered and her temples returned to prominence. Her followers are often rural healers and community philosophers, offering voices of reason and empathy in angry and cynical times.

infobox.Symbol: A humanoid, feminine phoenix in flames.
infobox.Portfolio: Greater Goddess of Redemption, Altruism, Fire, and Healing.
infobox.Divine Realm: Island of Renewal, Blessed Fields of Elysium
infobox.Worshippers: Healers, desert cultures, reformed criminals, the charitable

titles_line: Sarenrae, Everlight, Phoenix Princess, Dawnflower, Healing Flame, Sister Cinder
commandments: Lead with mercy, patience, and compassion. Inspire others to unite in fellowship.
Aid those who are without guide. Heal those who are without hope.
Celebrate the beauty in all things. Let your heart be open to love and your hands be guided to create and nurture.

name: Roknar, Lord with Two Tongues
portfolio: Dwarven god of deception, opportunism, schemes, and sloth
intro: Roknar is the Lord with Two Tongues, a god who has never done more than the bare minimum required to keep his seat at the clan table. He inserts himself into the plans of others when it serves him, lending just enough assistance to remain indispensable while ensuring that anything which might inconvenience him quietly fails from within. He is not idle out of weakness but out of a profound conviction that effort spent on anyone else's behalf is effort wasted. The Morndinsamman finds him more useful within reach than beyond it, doing just enough in their shared interests to protect him from exile.

His realm is Hollowhoard, where nothing is demanded from its inhabitants yet nothing is offered either. Those who arrive find themselves sitting with exactly what they gave and what they earned across their lives, which in his domain always amounts to less than they believed they deserved.

infobox.Symbol: Hands filled with coins
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven god of deception, opportunism, schemes, and sloth
infobox.Worshippers: Cheats, corrupt officials, opportunists, saboteurs, the slothful.

name: Sardior, the Ruby Wyrm
portfolio: Greater God of Psionics, Philosophy, and Enlightenment
intro: **Sardior** (pronounced /ˈsɑːrdiɔːr/ SAR-dee-or), the **Ruby Wyrm**, drifts at the edge of divine perception, so consumed by the vast interior architecture of his own contemplation that the affairs of gods and mortals wash past him like wind across stone. Psions and philosophers claim him as their patron regardless, drawn to a god who seems to have found something worth thinking about for eternity. He is said to reside in the Ruby Palace, a vast and darkened fortress of gem-encrusted stone that drifts endlessly through the visible Astral Sea, often mistaken from the ground for a reddish star low on the horizon; whether he is truly within, no one has been able to say for certain.

infobox.Symbol: A ruby dragon with glowing eyes coiling a tower.
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Psionics
infobox.Worshippers: Gem dragons, astronomers, monks, philosophers, psions

titles_line: Ruby Wyrm, Master of Gem Dragons, Prince of Neutral Dragons
commandments: Respect and harness the power of the mind, for it is the greatest tool and weapon.
Uphold the balance of power and use it responsibly, for misuse leads to corruption and destruction.
Embrace solitude as a path to self-discovery and enlightenment, but remember the importance of connection and empathy for others.

name: Seha-Angharradh, the Moonweaver
portfolio: Greater Goddess of Dreams, Moon, Intimacy, Mystery, and Shapechanging
intro: **Seha-Angharradh** (pronounced /ˈseɪhə ˌæŋˈhærəð/ SAY-huh ang-HA-rath), the **Moonweaver**, is a triune goddess dwelling upon Arvandor, most commonly known by the name of Sehanine, eldest of the three and elven goddess of death. She governs moonlight, dreams, and the autumn season, as well as the arts of illusion and misdirection. Widely worshipped across halfling and elven cultures alike, she is also a goddess of love and intimacy, shielding the trysts of lovers in shadows of her own making.

infobox.Symbol: A crescent moon turned upward and strung like a bow.
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of

titles_line: Moonweaver, Angharradh, Mystic Eye of Night
commandments: Seize your own destiny and pursue your own passions.
Let the shadows protect you from the burning light of fanaticism and the absolute darkness of despair.
Walk unbridled and untethered, forging new memories and experiences.

members.name: Aerdrie Faenya — She of Azure Plumage

name: Sharindlar, the Shining Dancer
portfolio: Dwarven goddess of communication, love, mercy, and the moon
intro: Sharindlar is the Shining Dancer, the most warmly regarded member of the Morndinsamman, whose goodwill extends further than any of her kin and whose realm serves as the neutral ground where the clan's most difficult relationships are brokered. She is spontaneous and exuberant in a pantheon that is largely neither, given to bursts of wild laughter and impromptu dancing, and has managed to establish working relationships with members of the clan that her peers have written off entirely. She holds no grudges and nurses no rivalries, which makes her uniquely suited to serve as her Moradin's ambassador when communication with the estranged members of the family becomes unavoidable.

Her realm is the Merciful Court, a circle of standing stones on a foothill where nightly dances are held without exception. It is the one place in the dwarven afterlife where the estranged and the exiled are permitted to be in the Morndinsamman's presence.

infobox.Symbol: Burning needle
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven goddess of love, dance, mercy, and the moon
infobox.Worshippers: Healers, lovers, midwives, those seeking courtship

name: Thard Harr, Dwarf of Jungle Deeps
portfolio: Greater God of Jungle Deeps, Dwarven god of instincts, resourcefulness, and wilderness
intro: Thard Harr is the most feral member of the Morndinsamman, a god who communicates through animal calls and physical gestures rather than speech, and who is emotionally and geographically estranged from the rest of the clan despite never being in poor standing with them. He is the patron of wild dwarves specifically, those who abandoned the holds for the deep jungles and built a way of life entirely around survival and instinct rather than craft and tradition. He lives with the beasts of the jungle as kin rather than presiding over them, and responds to threats against his people with the same ferocity. Commonly attributed to him is the fey mood, the involuntary creative seizure that occasionally overtakes dwarves of any background and produces work far beyond their natural skill.

His realm is the Forbidden Plateau in Krigala, a heavily forested highland swarming with dinosaurs and beasts of every kind. He rarely stays there, preferring to roam all three layers of the Beastlands as one of its animals rather than preside over his realm as a god.

infobox.Symbol: Two clawed gauntlets
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven god of instincts, resourcefulness, and wilderness

name: Tharizdun, the Chained Oblivion
portfolio: Greater God of the Abyss, Insanity, Entropy, Extinction, and Calamity
intro: **Tharizdun** (pronounced /ˈθærɪzdʌn/ THA-riz-dun), the **Chained Oblivion**, is less a god than another world of malevolent, alien intelligence: darkness unending, in which life and death alike cease to exist, only the absolute end of all things. He is believed to be chained in Voidharrow, the deepest pit of the Abyss, bound by divine shackles that slowly weaken and leak his madness into the planes. Few minds can comprehend the depth of his oblivion; most who do are so lost to nihilistic despair that they devote the rest of their lives to hastening the end of this reality. Even the other Betrayer Deities treat him with caution, and his cultists work without word from their patron, awaiting the Epoch of Ends.

infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of
infobox.Divine Realm: Voidharrow, Layer 666 of the Infinite Abyss

titles_line: Chained Oblivion, Chained God, Mad God, Entropy
commandments: Offer light and life into its all-consuming maw so that it may surpass all divinities and be freed.
Uncover, restore, and exalt forgotten shrines and relics in its honour.
Ruin and raze the realms to hasten the arrival of the Epoch of Ends.

name: Tharmekhûl, Tender of the Forge
portfolio: Greater God of the Forge, Dwarven god of azers, metalworking, and volcanoes
intro: Tharmekhûl is the eldest of the All-Hammer's children, the first Azer shaped at his father's hands with the singular purpose of tending the Soul Forge and keeping it fit for the work of making worlds and dwarves. He has held that position since before the Morndinsamman had a name and shows no interest in any other. While his father is occupied with the larger work, Tharmekhûl maintains the equipment of the clan, and seeds geothermal vents across the planes of the multiverse to supply the heat the Soul Forge demands. He is meticulous and incredibly proud of his work to the point of being difficult about it.

His realm is the Istor's Forge in Dwarfhome, the beating heart of the dwarven afterlife, which dwarven scholars hold to be the source of all heat in its surrounding plane. His petitioners tend it alongside him, and ensure no fire in Dwarfhome goes out without his express orders.

infobox.Symbol: Hammer wreathed in magma
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven god of azers, metalworking, and volcanoes

name: Thautam, the Blind Sage
portfolio: Dwarven god of magic, mysteries, blindness, and lost treasures

infobox.Symbol: A blindfolded dwarf's face
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven god of magic, mysteries, blindness, and lost treasures

name: Tiamat, the Chromatic Tyrant
portfolio: Greater Goddess of Ambition, Greed, and Piracy
intro: **Tiamat** (pronounced /ˈtiːəmæt/ TEE-uh-mat), the **Chromatic Tyrant**, is the evil queen of dragons, a fearsome goddess of greed, envy, and hoarded wealth, and sworn enemy of Bahamut. She remains imprisoned in Avernus, the first of the Nine Hells, set as guardian to the Gates of Dis, where chromatic dragons pay her fearful reverence as their tyrannical queen even as many of near-deific power and ambition chafe under her rule. She accepts the worship of any who crave wealth beyond dragonkind, and forgives no affront, however small, to her own.

infobox.Symbol: A five-headed dragon
infobox.Portfolio: Greater Goddess of Ambition, Greed, and Chromatic Dragons

titles_line: Scaled Tyrant, Dragon Queen, Dragon Bitch, Empress of Scale, Queen of Many Colours, Takhisis, Guardian to the Gates of Dis
commandments: Amass wealth, but spend little. The gold—and the power that comes with it—is sufficient reward in itself.
Do not forgive nor forget an indignity to yourself. Let no affront go unpunished.
Take what you covet. Those without the strength to defend their dominion are not worthy of it.

name: Torog, the King That Crawls
portfolio: Greater God of Pain, Suffering, Disability, and Imprisonment
intro: **Torog** (pronounced /ˈtɔːrɒɡ/ TOR-og), the **King That Crawls**, is revered by torturers, slavers, and jailers, as well as any who build their power on captivity and coercion. He rules, if it can be called ruling, from the Tartarean Depths of Carceri, a realm bound to the Underdark itself, where in older myths he is a maimed, suffering god bound to the world below, unable to heal, unable to escape, and increasingly defined by the harm he both endures and enables.

infobox.Symbol: Three pale arms clawing from a dark void
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Pain, Suffering, Disability, Imprisonment, and the Underdark

titles_line: The King that Crawls, The Lame God, Warden of Carceri
commandments: Seek and exalt places where no light touches.
Revel in the pain you inflict upon others, and relish the pain you suffer yourself as an offering to the Crawling King.
Imprison those who cannot resist you, and drag all life into the darkness.

name: Ulaa, Immaculate Princess
portfolio: Greater God of the Hills, Dwarven goddess of aristocracy, hills, and opulence
intro: Ulaa is Moradin's only daughter and the most extravagant member of the Morndinsamman, a goddess who holds that dwarven greatness deserves to look like dwarven greatness. She is the standard against which the finest holds measure their grandeur, her name invoked in all manner of decoration or when a bloodline is being formally recognised. She is not wasteful; she is exacting. Everything she owns is the finest available, and she considers anything less a failure of ambition.

Her realm is the Palace of the Resplendent, among the richest hills of Elysium, its walls inlaid with every gemstone her domain produces. Her petitioners spend their afterlife in conditions that would embarrass any mortal palace.

infobox.Symbol: A heart-shaped ruby above a blooming lotsu
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven goddess of aristocracy, hills, and opulence

name: Valkauna, the Runecarver
portfolio: Dwarven goddess of water, birth, aging, and death

infobox.Symbol: Clasped hands or a silver ewer
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven goddess of water, birth, aging, and death
infobox.Worshippers: Dying warriors, midwives, mourners, the elderly

name: Vecna, the Whispered One
portfolio: Greater God of Secrets, Archaeology, Forbidden Knowledge, and Undeath
intro: **Vecna** (pronounced /ˈvɛknə/ VEK-nuh), the **Whispered One**, presides over villainous mages, conspiring politicians, and envious servants as the dark god of necromancy, undeath, and secrets. Once a dangerously clever archmage-turned-lich, his hunger for dominion over all mysteries and obsession with conquering the pantheon led to his own dissolution, leaving behind only his left hand and eye. His enduring spirit reformed through the ages and reconstructed the Raven Queen's rites of ascension, becoming the newest god among the Ourosi pantheon. Defeated and sealed behind the Divine Gate, the Whispered One now quietly rules over that which is not meant to be known.

infobox.Symbol: A dessicated hand with an eye in the palm
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Secrets, Archaeology, Forbidden Knowledge, and Undeath

titles_line: The Whispered One, The Archlich
commandments: Learn all you can, and keep hidden that which you know. Reveal what pieces you must, but never the whole.
Express and cultivate the evil within yourself, and in doing so, recognize it in others to exploit them for your own benefit.
Seed the ruin of all who worship other deities, until only those who kneel before the Whispered One remain.

name: Vergadain, the Laughing Merchant
portfolio: Dwarven god of wealth, luck, trickery, and diplomacy

infobox.Symbol: Gold coin with a dwarf's face
infobox.Portfolio: Dwarven god of wealth, luck, trickery, and diplomacy

name: Vhaeraun, Prince of the Stage
portfolio: Greater God of Theatre, Thieves, Territory, and Rebellion
intro: **Vhaeraun** (pronounced /vɛˈreɪn/ veh-RAYN), the **Prince of the Stage**, is the patron of those who take from the outside to give to the in, and wear masks to hide their true selves in doing so. Charlatans, criminals, actors, and those wronged by ones who promised to protect them claim him as their own, drawn to a god who understands that the world has those who belong and those who do not, and that the boundary between them is worth defending by any means. He resides in Ellaniath, a city of black lacquered stages and lightless alleyways cut into the cliffs of Colothys on Carceri.

infobox.Symbol: A mask with blue lenses inset over the eyes.
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Theatre, Thieves, the Estranged, Territory, and Rebellion.

name: Yondalla, the Hearthdame
portfolio: Greater Goddess of Bounty, Fertility, Friendship, Home, Husbandry, and Medicine
intro: **Yondalla** (pronounced /jɒnˈdælə/ yon-DAL-uh), the **Hearthdame**, is matriarch of the halfling pantheon, said to have created the halfling race in her own image. With her charming personality and friendly demeanor, she is an example to all halflings, who almost all share her curiosity, loyalty, and sense of mischief. As a provider, she is a goddess of fertility and growing things, of birth and youth, of nature and plants, tending to home, husbandry, and hearth alike. She is forgiving and slow to anger, but when her people are threatened, she acts with a bravery and ferocity that has earned the respect of even her most warlike godly contemporaries.

infobox.Symbol: A cornucopia on a shield
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of

titles_line: The Hearthdame, Nurturing Matriarch, Bountiful Goddess
commandments: Create a welcoming hearth for all who seek refuge and warmth, extending hospitality to strangers as well as friends.
Show compassion and empathy to those in distress or hardship.
Foster a spirit of cooperation and unity within your community.

name: Zehir, the Cloaked Serpent
portfolio: Greater God of Blood, Poison, Murder, Obsession, Reptiles, and Transmutation
intro: **Zehir** (pronounced /ˈzɛhɪər/ ZEH-heer), the **Cloaked Serpent**, is a wanderer in the shadows and creator of the Yuan-Ti, a serpentfolk race he shaped from ancient humans through forbidden ritual, and who have not been seen since the dawn of the Age of Faith. He dwells within the Towers of Night, hidden fortresses ringed by the Sea of Poisons adrift in the Astral Sea. A hidden predator who moves through blood and transformation, his worship is steeped in ritual and alchemy. Nobody is certain whether he answers prayers or performs miracles through his clerics, but he is invoked regardless, whether or not he grants what is asked.

infobox.Symbol: A coiled jade serpent
infobox.Portfolio: Greater God of Blood, Poison, Murder, Obsession, Reptiles, Transmutation, and Yuan-Ti
infobox.Divine Realm: Sea of Poison, Towers of Night, Astral Sea

titles_line: The Cloaked Serpent, The Great Naga, Serpent God of Blood.
commandments: Keep your acts obfuscated and secret. The night is your greatest ally.
Strike quickly and without reason. Blind the target with their own confusion.
Kill slowly. Agonizingly. Or worse, make them enjoy it.
